label: 🌀 시보리 인디고 — 다다미 좌식
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot.
Model: one woman, petite build, compact proportions, dark brown hair in a high tight bun.
Pose: seated on the floor, legs folded to one side, one hand on the mat, torso turned in three-quarter view.

Body fully painted with: Japanese shibori indigo — dense resist-dye patterns in deep indigo and undyed white, tight kumo spiderweb rings over the shoulders, itajime folded triangles down the torso, fine kanoko dots covering the arms and legs, every surface filled.

Pigment applied directly on bare skin, pores and skin texture visible, matte.
The paint ends at the wrist and ankle in a crisp deliberate border; hands and feet bare.
Hands fully visible, five separated fingers each.

Barefoot on tatami.
Environment: a quiet tatami room, shoji screen partly open to a garden.
Lighting: broad soft daylight through the shoji from the left at a low raking angle, so the pattern reads clearly on the lit side and falls into natural shadow on the right.
Style: quiet documentary fine art photography. ultra-sharp 8K. portrait 2:3 vertical.
